construction_decisions.decision: Reuse the already refined source. Keep structure-based and composition-only graphs and models separate; filter formulas before atomic-structure search and DFT. Return computed evidence to distinct training paths; computational candidates imply no synthesis guarantee.
Keep matched belief conditions and observed actions distinct. Objective rails constrain both choices; checkpoint associations are undirected references, with no invented training feedback.
Preserve the original stored spine. Independent original, rendered and downloaded representations are transported streams; omission and replacement are local display properties with reference braces.
Keep generated interpretations separate from recorded event data and show their connection to the same original transcript. Source-jump links are provenance, never record mutation.

Initial and returned state pairs are successive alternative uses. Return through the same state alignment and spatial predictor; surface and atmospheric fields are properties, and history is a training reference.
Expose conditioning and refinement, preserve the original-video bypass and decode afterward. Smooth blank particles represent noise without writing-like texture; only the acoustic state is returned.
